documents.text:
Twenty tools were consolidated into six action-based tools. get_decision maps to decision with the documented required action="get". SQLite schema and selected read results are unchanged.
Public repository: https://github.com/fastmcp-me/mcp-sqlew
Old commit: b611a95f3ee902984b546efe1214299fa12005b9
New commit: e0ffc4cb77e6d320aae2a3e929fdb4115d424132
Evidence: https://github.com/fastmcp-me/mcp-sqlew/blob/e0ffc4cb77e6d320aae2a3e929fdb4115d424132/MIGRATION_v2.md
Only the selected documented operation is a target; no gate or sealed observations are provided.

newContracts.description: Manage decisions (actions: set, get, list, search_tags, search_layer, versions)
newContracts.name: decision

oldContract.description: Get a specific decision by key. Returns full metadata including tags, layer, scopes, version, and timestamp.
oldContract.name: get_decision
